def build(p):
    # Base cylinder with top and bottom chamfers
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(p.knob_od / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.knob_h)
        .edges("%CIRCLE")
        .chamfer(p.outer_chamfer)
    )

    # Cut perimeter finger flutes for hand grip
    flute_center_r = p.knob_od / 2.0 + p.flute_r - p.flute_depth
    for i in range(int(p.flute_count)):
        ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / p.flute_count)
        fx = flute_center_r * math.cos(ang)
        fy = flute_center_r * math.sin(ang)
        flute = (
            cq.Workplane("XY")
            .center(fx, fy)
            .circle(p.flute_r)
            .extrude(p.knob_h)
        )
        body = body.cut(flute)

    # Coaxial through-clearance hole for M5 bolt shank
    bolt_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(p.bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.knob_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)

    # Clean recessed hex nut pocket from top face down to internal shoulder floor
    pocket_floor_z = p.knob_h - p.pocket_depth
    hex_circum_d = p.pocket_af * 2.0 / math.sqrt(3.0)
    hex_pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=pocket_floor_z)
        .polygon(6, hex_circum_d)
        .extrude(p.pocket_depth)
    )
    body = body.cut(hex_pocket)

    return body

        )

            cq.Workplane("XY")
            .workplane(offset=pocket_floor_z)
            .center(cx, 0)
            .polygon(6, hex_circum_d)
            .extrude(p.pocket_depth)
        )
        body = body.cut(hex_pocket)

    return body
